title: 渦輪分子泵與真空計
subcategoryTitle: 低溫、真空與精密實驗平台
summary: 以一台 DN100、約 260 L/s 的混合軸承渦輪分子泵與它的泵站為對象：從分子流下葉片把動量傳給氣體分子出發，理解壓縮比為何隨分子量呈指數變化、前級壓力如何決定極限壓力；再把轉子材料與動平衡、電容薄膜計、Pirani、Penning 與 Bayard–Alpert 真空計的物理與校正鏈、抽速量測與互鎖整合成可驗收的真空泵站。
summaryEn: Built around a DN100, roughly 260 L/s hybrid-bearing turbomolecular pump and its pumping station: start from blades handing momentum to gas molecules in molecular flow to see why the compression ratio grows exponentially with molecular mass and how foreline pressure sets the ultimate pressure, then integrate rotor materials and balancing, the physics and calibration chain of capacitance-diaphragm, Pirani, Penning and Bayard–Alpert gauges, pumping-speed measurement and interlocks into a pumping station that can be accepted.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分子流下的葉片動量傳遞」與「壓縮比、前級壓力與極限壓力」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Blade momentum transfer in molecular flow" and "Compression ratio, foreline pressure and ultimate pressure": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分子流下的葉片動量傳遞：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Blade momentum transfer in molecular flow: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「轉子葉片與氣體分子」如何決定渦輪分子泵與真空計的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rotor blades and gas molecules” determines the key performance of “Turbomolecular pumps and vacuum gauges”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在分子流中，撞上葉片表面的分子會以漫反射重新發射，並疊加上葉片表面的速度；當葉尖速度與分子熱速度 c̄ = √(8kT/πm) 同量級時，傾斜的葉片讓從入口側來的分子較容易被送到出口側、反向的分子較難穿透，單級形成一個方向性的傳輸機率差，數十級轉子與定子交替串聯後得到很高的壓縮比。因為 c̄ 隨 1/√M 增加，氫分子比氮快 3.7 倍，同一組葉片對氫的「追得上」程度差很多，壓縮比隨 √M 呈指數變化。入口的最大抽速則受限於入口截面與捕獲機率，與葉片轉得多快關係不大。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「轉子葉片與氣體分子」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In molecular flow a molecule striking a blade is re-emitted diffusely with the blade's surface velocity added; when the blade-tip speed is comparable to the molecular thermal speed c̄ = √(8kT/πm), the inclined blades let molecules arriving from the inlet side pass to the outlet side more readily than the reverse, each stage producing a directional difference in transmission probability, and tens of alternating rotor and stator stages in series multiply into a very high compression ratio. Because c̄ grows as 1/√M, hydrogen moves 3.7 times faster than nitrogen, the blades keep up with it far less well, and the compression ratio therefore varies exponentially with √M. The maximum inlet pumping speed is bounded by the inlet cross-section and the capture probability and depends little on how fast the blades turn. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Rotor blades and gas molecules”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：轉子 90,000 rpm = 1500 rev/s、直徑 0.1 m，葉尖速度 v = π·D·n ≈ 471 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A rotor at 90,000 rpm = 1500 rev/s with 0.1 m diameter has a tip speed v = π·D·n ≈ 471 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「渦輪泵對所有氣體的壓縮比都一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A turbopump compresses every gas by the same ratio." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「轉子葉片與氣體分子」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Rotor blades and gas molecules”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：渦輪泵對所有氣體的壓縮比都一樣。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A turbopump compresses every gas by the same ratio. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分子流下的葉片動量傳遞」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Blade momentum transfer in molecular flow" is correct?
options: 渦輪泵對所有氣體的壓縮比都一樣。
在分子流中，撞上葉片表面的分子會以漫反射重新發射，並疊加上葉片表面的速度。
前級壓力只要低於 1 mbar，對渦輪泵入口壓力就沒有影響。
optionsEn: A turbopump compresses every gas by the same ratio.
In molecular flow a molecule striking a blade is re-emitted diffusely with the blade's surface velocity added.
As long as the foreline stays below 1 mbar it has no effect on the inlet pressure.
quiz.explanation: 在分子流中，撞上葉片表面的分子會以漫反射重新發射，並疊加上葉片表面的速度；當葉尖速度與分子熱速度 c̄ = √(8kT/πm) 同量級時，傾斜的葉片讓從入口側來的分子較容易被送到出口側、反向的分子較難穿透，單級形成一個方向性的傳輸機率差，數十級轉子與定子交替串聯後得到很高的壓縮比。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In molecular flow a molecule striking a blade is re-emitted diffusely with the blade's surface velocity added; when the blade-tip speed is comparable to the molecular thermal speed c̄ = √(8kT/πm), the inclined blades let molecules arriving from the inlet side pass to the outlet side more readily than the reverse, each stage producing a directional difference in transmission probability, and tens of alternating rotor and stator stages in series multiply into a very high compression ratio. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分子流下的葉片動量傳遞：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Blade momentum transfer in molecular flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉子葉片與氣體分子」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rotor blades and gas molecules” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：轉子 90,000 rpm = 1500 rev/s、直徑 0.1 m，葉尖速度 v = π·D·n ≈ 471 m/s。氮在 293 K 的 c̄ = √(8×1.38×10⁻²³×293/(π×28×1.66×10⁻²⁷)) ≈ 471 m/s，兩者相當；氫的 c̄ ≈ 471×√14 ≈ 1760 m/s，v/c̄ 只有 0.27。壓縮比寫成 K₀ ∝ exp(a·√M)：若純渦輪級對氮 K₀ = 10⁸，則 a·√28 = 18.4，a ≈ 3.48，對氫 K₀ ≈ exp(3.48×√2) ≈ 140（教學估算；實際混合泵靠 Holweck 段把氫壓縮比拉到 10³–10⁵）。入口抽速上限 S ≈ 11.6·A·α，DN100 入口 A ≈ 78.5 cm²，捕獲機率 α ≈ 0.3，S ≈ 273 L/s，與 DN100 泵約 260 L/s 的標稱值相符。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A rotor at 90,000 rpm = 1500 rev/s with 0.1 m diameter has a tip speed v = π·D·n ≈ 471 m/s. Nitrogen at 293 K has c̄ = √(8×1.38×10⁻²³×293/(π×28×1.66×10⁻²⁷)) ≈ 471 m/s, a match; hydrogen has c̄ ≈ 471×√14 ≈ 1760 m/s, so v/c̄ is only 0.27. Writing K₀ ∝ exp(a·√M): if pure turbo stages give K₀ = 10⁸ for nitrogen then a·√28 = 18.4, a ≈ 3.48 and K₀ ≈ exp(3.48×√2) ≈ 140 for hydrogen (teaching estimate; real hybrid pumps use Holweck stages to lift hydrogen compression to 10³–10⁵). The inlet speed limit S ≈ 11.6·A·α with A ≈ 78.5 cm² for DN100 and capture probability α ≈ 0.3 gives S ≈ 273 L/s, consistent with the roughly 260 L/s nameplate of a DN100 pump. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用流量計法分別對氮、氦與氫量抽速，確認三者只差百分之幾十，而壓縮比卻差數個數量級：把入口封死、從前級注入測試氣體，記錄前級壓力與入口壓力，零流量時的比值就是 K₀；對氫要用入口的殘氣分析儀讀分壓，因為總壓計被氮當量主導。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure pumping speed by the flow-meter method separately for nitrogen, helium and hydrogen, confirming they differ by only tens of percent while the compression ratios differ by orders of magnitude: blank off the inlet, feed test gas into the foreline, log foreline and inlet pressure, and the zero-flow ratio is K₀; for hydrogen read the inlet partial pressure with a residual-gas analyser because the total-pressure gauge is dominated by the nitrogen equivalent.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 轉子 90,000 rpm = 1500 rev/s、直徑 0.1 m，葉尖速度 v = π·D·n ≈ 471 m/s。氮在 293 K 的 c̄ = √(8×1.38×10⁻²³×293/(π×28×1.66×10⁻²⁷)) ≈ 471 m/s，兩者相當；氫的 c̄ ≈ 471×√14 ≈ 1760 m/s，v/c̄ 只有 0.27。壓縮比寫成 K₀ ∝ exp(a·√M)：若純渦輪級對氮 K₀ = 10⁸，則 a·√28 = 18.4，a ≈ 3.48，對氫 K₀ ≈ exp(3.48×√2) ≈ 140（教學估算；實際混合泵靠 Holweck 段把氫壓縮比拉到 10³–10⁵）。入口抽速上限 S ≈ 11.6·A·α，DN100 入口 A ≈ 78.5 cm²，捕獲機率 α ≈ 0.3，S ≈ 273 L/s，與 DN100 泵約 260 L/s 的標稱值相符。
knowledge.textEn: A rotor at 90,000 rpm = 1500 rev/s with 0.1 m diameter has a tip speed v = π·D·n ≈ 471 m/s. Nitrogen at 293 K has c̄ = √(8×1.38×10⁻²³×293/(π×28×1.66×10⁻²⁷)) ≈ 471 m/s, a match; hydrogen has c̄ ≈ 471×√14 ≈ 1760 m/s, so v/c̄ is only 0.27. Writing K₀ ∝ exp(a·√M): if pure turbo stages give K₀ = 10⁸ for nitrogen then a·√28 = 18.4, a ≈ 3.48 and K₀ ≈ exp(3.48×√2) ≈ 140 for hydrogen (teaching estimate; real hybrid pumps use Holweck stages to lift hydrogen compression to 10³–10⁵). knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「分子流下的葉片動量傳遞」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Blade momentum transfer in molecular flow", which statement holds?
options: Pirani 計的讀值與氣體種類無關。
泵銘牌上的抽速就是腔體得到的抽速。
轉子 90,000 rpm = 1500 rev/s、直徑 0.1 m，葉尖速度 v = π·D·n ≈ 471 m/s。
optionsEn: A Pirani reading does not depend on the gas species.
The nameplate pumping speed is what the chamber actually receives.
A rotor at 90,000 rpm = 1500 rev/s with 0.1 m diameter has a tip speed v = π·D·n ≈ 471 m/s.
quiz.explanation: 轉子 90,000 rpm = 1500 rev/s、直徑 0.1 m，葉尖速度 v = π·D·n ≈ 471 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A rotor at 90,000 rpm = 1500 rev/s with 0.1 m diameter has a tip speed v = π·D·n ≈ 471 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分子流下的葉片動量傳遞：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Blade momentum transfer in molecular flow: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「轉子葉片與氣體分子」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Rotor blades and gas molecules” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用流量計法分別對氮、氦與氫量抽速，確認三者只差百分之幾十，而壓縮比卻差數個數量級：把入口封死、從前級注入測試氣體，記錄前級壓力與入口壓力，零流量時的比值就是 K₀；對氫要用入口的殘氣分析儀讀分壓，因為總壓計被氮當量主導。把量到的 K₀(N₂)、K₀(He)、K₀(H₂) 對 √M 作半對數圖，應近似一條直線。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure pumping speed by the flow-meter method separately for nitrogen, helium and hydrogen, confirming they differ by only tens of percent while the compression ratios differ by orders of magnitude: blank off the inlet, feed test gas into the foreline, log foreline and inlet pressure, and the zero-flow ratio is K₀; for hydrogen read the inlet partial pressure with a residual-gas analyser because the total-pressure gauge is dominated by the nitrogen equivalent. Plotting the measured K₀ for N₂, He and H₂ against √M on a semi-log scale should give roughly a straight line. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：極限壓力被氫回流卡住：前級中氫分壓 10⁻⁴ mbar，若泵對氫的 K₀ 只有 10³，入口氫分壓就是 10⁻⁷ mbar，永遠進不了超高真空；症狀是入口殘氣譜的氫峰隨前級壓力同步起伏，換更大的渦輪泵也沒用，要改的是對氫的壓縮比或前級泵。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: The ultimate pressure is pinned by hydrogen backflow: with a hydrogen partial pressure of 10⁻⁴ mbar in the foreline and a pump whose K₀ for hydrogen is only 10³, the inlet hydrogen partial pressure is 10⁻⁷ mbar and ultrahigh vacuum is never reached; the symptom is an inlet hydrogen peak that rises and falls in step with the foreline pressure, a bigger turbopump does not help, and what must change is the hydrogen compression or the backing pump.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用流量計法分別對氮、氦與氫量抽速，確認三者只差百分之幾十，而壓縮比卻差數個數量級：把入口封死、從前級注入測試氣體，記錄前級壓力與入口壓力，零流量時的比值就是 K₀；對氫要用入口的殘氣分析儀讀分壓，因為總壓計被氮當量主導。把量到的 K₀(N₂)、K₀(He)、K₀(H₂) 對 √M 作半對數圖，應近似一條直線。
knowledge.textEn: Measure pumping speed by the flow-meter method separately for nitrogen, helium and hydrogen, confirming they differ by only tens of percent while the compression ratios differ by orders of magnitude: blank off the inlet, feed test gas into the foreline, log foreline and inlet pressure, and the zero-flow ratio is K₀; for hydrogen read the inlet partial pressure with a residual-gas analyser because the total-pressure gauge is dominated by the nitrogen equivalent. Plotting the measured K₀ for N₂, He and H₂ against √M on a semi-log scale should give roughly a straight line.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分子流下的葉片動量傳遞」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Blade momentum transfer in molecular flow"?
options: 用流量計法分別對氮、氦與氫量抽速，確認三者只差百分之幾十，而壓縮比卻差數個數量級：把入口封死、從前級注入測試氣體，記錄前級壓力與入口壓力，零流量時的比值就是 K₀。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
渦輪泵只要在轉，任何腔體壓力下都可以開閘閥。
optionsEn: Measure pumping speed by the flow-meter method separately for nitrogen, helium and hydrogen, confirming they differ by only tens of percent while the compression ratios differ by orders of magnitude: blank off the inlet, feed test gas into the foreline, log foreline and inlet pressure, and the zero-flow ratio is K₀.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Once the turbopump is spinning the gate valve can be opened at any chamber pressure.
quiz.explanation: 用流量計法分別對氮、氦與氫量抽速，確認三者只差百分之幾十，而壓縮比卻差數個數量級：把入口封死、從前級注入測試氣體，記錄前級壓力與入口壓力，零流量時的比值就是 K₀；對氫要用入口的殘氣分析儀讀分壓，因為總壓計被氮當量主導。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure pumping speed by the flow-meter method separately for nitrogen, helium and hydrogen, confirming they differ by only tens of percent while the compression ratios differ by orders of magnitude: blank off the inlet, feed test gas into the foreline, log foreline and inlet pressure, and the zero-flow ratio is K₀; for hydrogen read the inlet partial pressure with a residual-gas analyser because the total-pressure gauge is dominated by the nitrogen equivalent. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 分子流下的葉片動量傳遞：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Blade momentum transfer in molecular flow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉子葉片與氣體分子」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Rotor blades and gas molecules” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 極限壓力被氫回流卡住：前級中氫分壓 10⁻⁴ mbar，若泵對氫的 K₀ 只有 10³，入口氫分壓就是 10⁻⁷ mbar，永遠進不了超高真空；症狀是入口殘氣譜的氫峰隨前級壓力同步起伏，換更大的渦輪泵也沒用，要改的是對氫的壓縮比或前級泵。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: The ultimate pressure is pinned by hydrogen backflow: with a hydrogen partial pressure of 10⁻⁴ mbar in the foreline and a pump whose K₀ for hydrogen is only 10³, the inlet hydrogen partial pressure is 10⁻⁷ mbar and ultrahigh vacuum is never reached; the symptom is an inlet hydrogen peak that rises and falls in step with the foreline pressure, a bigger turbopump does not help, and what must change is the hydrogen compression or the backing pump. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：入口的最大抽速則受限於入口截面與捕獲機率，與葉片轉得多快關係不大。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The maximum inlet pumping speed is bounded by the inlet cross-section and the capture probability and depends little on how fast the blades turn.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「渦輪泵對所有氣體的壓縮比都一樣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A turbopump compresses every gas by the same ratio." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 極限壓力被氫回流卡住：前級中氫分壓 10⁻⁴ mbar，若泵對氫的 K₀ 只有 10³，入口氫分壓就是 10⁻⁷ mbar，永遠進不了超高真空；症狀是入口殘氣譜的氫峰隨前級壓力同步起伏，換更大的渦輪泵也沒用，要改的是對氫的壓縮比或前級泵。
knowledge.textEn: The ultimate pressure is pinned by hydrogen backflow: with a hydrogen partial pressure of 10⁻⁴ mbar in the foreline and a pump whose K₀ for hydrogen is only 10³, the inlet hydrogen partial pressure is 10⁻⁷ mbar and ultrahigh vacuum is never reached; the symptom is an inlet hydrogen peak that rises and falls in step with the foreline pressure, a bigger turbopump does not help, and what must change is the hydrogen compression or the backing pump.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分子流下的葉片動量傳遞」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Blade momentum transfer in molecular flow" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
極限壓力被氫回流卡住：前級中氫分壓 10⁻⁴ mbar，若泵對氫的 K₀ 只有 10³，入口氫分壓就是 10⁻⁷ mbar，永遠進不了超高真空。
前級壓力只要低於 1 mbar，對渦輪泵入口壓力就沒有影響。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

The ultimate pressure is pinned by hydrogen backflow: with a hydrogen partial pressure of 10⁻⁴ mbar in the foreline and a pump whose K₀ for hydrogen is only 10³, the inlet hydrogen partial pressure is 10⁻⁷ mbar and ultrahigh vacuum is never reached.
As long as the foreline stays below 1 mbar it has no effect on the inlet pressure.
quiz.explanation: 極限壓力被氫回流卡住：前級中氫分壓 10⁻⁴ mbar，若泵對氫的 K₀ 只有 10³，入口氫分壓就是 10⁻⁷ mbar，永遠進不了超高真空；症狀是入口殘氣譜的氫峰隨前級壓力同步起伏，換更大的渦輪泵也沒用，要改的是對氫的壓縮比或前級泵。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: The ultimate pressure is pinned by hydrogen backflow: with a hydrogen partial pressure of 10⁻⁴ mbar in the foreline and a pump whose K₀ for hydrogen is only 10³, the inlet hydrogen partial pressure is 10⁻⁷ mbar and ultrahigh vacuum is never reached; the symptom is an inlet hydrogen peak that rises and falls in step with the foreline pressure, a bigger turbopump does not help, and what must change is the hydrogen compression or the backing pump. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 壓縮比、前級壓力與極限壓力：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Compression ratio, foreline pressure and ultimate pressure: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「前級管路與 Holweck 段」如何決定渦輪分子泵與真空計的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Foreline and Holweck stage” determines the key performance of “Turbomolecular pumps and vacuum gauges”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 渦輪級只在分子流下工作，入口壓力高於約 10⁻² mbar 時葉片間的分子互撞使壓縮失效，所以渦輪泵一定需要前級泵。混合泵在渦輪級之後加上 Holweck 螺旋槽拖曳段，把容許的前級壓力拉高到數 mbar，因此能用隔膜泵或小型渦卷泵做前級。零流量壓縮比 K₀ 決定每種氣體從前級回流到入口的分壓，入口極限壓力是各氣體 p_fore,i/K₀,i 的總和再加上出氣量除以抽速；重氣體的 K₀ 高達 10¹¹，前級成分只對氫與氦重要。高氣體流量時轉子被氣體摩擦加熱，馬達功率與轉子溫度上限（鋁合金潛變）決定了泵的最大流量與最大前級壓力。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「前級管路與 Holweck 段」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Turbo stages work only in molecular flow; above roughly 10⁻² mbar at the inlet, intermolecular collisions between the blades destroy the compression, so a turbopump always needs a backing pump. Hybrid pumps add Holweck spiral-groove drag stages behind the turbo stages, raising the permitted foreline pressure to several millibar so that a diaphragm pump or a small scroll pump can serve as backing. The zero-flow compression ratio K₀ sets the partial pressure of each gas that leaks back from foreline to inlet, and the inlet ultimate pressure is the sum of p_fore,i/K₀,i over the gases plus outgassing divided by pumping speed; for heavy gases K₀ reaches 10¹¹, so the foreline composition matters only for hydrogen and helium. At high throughput gas friction heats the rotor, and the motor power together with the rotor temperature limit (creep of the aluminium alloy) fixes the pump's maximum throughput and maximum foreline pressure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Foreline and Holweck stage”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：入口極限壓力 p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Inlet ultimate pressure p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「前級壓力只要低於 1 mbar，對渦輪泵入口壓力就沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as the foreline stays below 1 mbar it has no effect on the inlet pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「前級管路與 Holweck 段」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Foreline and Holweck stage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壓縮比、前級壓力與極限壓力
knowledge.titleEn: Compression ratio, foreline pressure and ultimate pressure
knowledge.text: 渦輪級只在分子流下工作，入口壓力高於約 10⁻² mbar 時葉片間的分子互撞使壓縮失效，所以渦輪泵一定需要前級泵。混合泵在渦輪級之後加上 Holweck 螺旋槽拖曳段，把容許的前級壓力拉高到數 mbar，因此能用隔膜泵或小型渦卷泵做前級。
knowledge.textEn: Turbo stages work only in molecular flow; above roughly 10⁻² mbar at the inlet, intermolecular collisions between the blades destroy the compression, so a turbopump always needs a backing pump. Hybrid pumps add Holweck spiral-groove drag stages behind the turbo stages, raising the permitted foreline pressure to several millibar so that a diaphragm pump or a small scroll pump can serve as backing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：前級壓力只要低於 1 mbar，對渦輪泵入口壓力就沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as the foreline stays below 1 mbar it has no effect on the inlet pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓縮比、前級壓力與極限壓力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Compression ratio, foreline pressure and ultimate pressure" is correct?
options: 前級壓力只要低於 1 mbar，對渦輪泵入口壓力就沒有影響。
渦輪泵只是個轉得快的風扇，撞機頂多換一台泵。
渦輪級只在分子流下工作，入口壓力高於約 10⁻² mbar 時葉片間的分子互撞使壓縮失效，所以渦輪泵一定需要前級泵。
optionsEn: As long as the foreline stays below 1 mbar it has no effect on the inlet pressure.
A turbopump is just a fast fan, and a crash at worst means replacing the pump.
Turbo stages work only in molecular flow.
quiz.explanation: 渦輪級只在分子流下工作，入口壓力高於約 10⁻² mbar 時葉片間的分子互撞使壓縮失效，所以渦輪泵一定需要前級泵。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Turbo stages work only in molecular flow; above roughly 10⁻² mbar at the inlet, intermolecular collisions between the blades destroy the compression, so a turbopump always needs a backing pump. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓縮比、前級壓力與極限壓力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Compression ratio, foreline pressure and ultimate pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「前級管路與 Holweck 段」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Foreline and Holweck stage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：入口極限壓力 p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S。前級總壓 5×10⁻² mbar（渦卷泵），其中氫分壓 1×10⁻⁴ mbar（教學假設）。氮：5×10⁻²/10¹¹ = 5×10⁻¹³ mbar，可忽略。氫：混合泵 K₀(H₂) = 10⁵ 時為 10⁻⁴/10⁵ = 1×10⁻⁹ mbar；舊式純渦輪泵 K₀(H₂) = 10³ 時為 1×10⁻⁷ mbar。若腔體氫出氣 Q = 2×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s、S = 260 L/s，出氣項為 7.7×10⁻¹² mbar，比氫回流項小得多，所以這台泵站的下限由前級氫分壓與 K₀(H₂) 決定，而不是由泵的抽速決定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Inlet ultimate pressure p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S. Foreline total 5×10⁻² mbar from a scroll pump, with a hydrogen partial pressure of 1×10⁻⁴ mbar (teaching assumption). Nitrogen: 5×10⁻²/10¹¹ = 5×10⁻¹³ mbar, negligible. Hydrogen: with a hybrid pump of K₀(H₂) = 10⁵ it is 10⁻⁴/10⁵ = 1×10⁻⁹ mbar; with an older pure turbo pump of K₀(H₂) = 10³ it is 1×10⁻⁷ mbar. If chamber hydrogen outgassing is Q = 2×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s and S = 260 L/s, the outgassing term is 7.7×10⁻¹² mbar, far below the hydrogen backflow term, so this station's floor is set by foreline hydrogen and K₀(H₂), not by the pump's speed. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量 K₀：封住入口，從前級以針閥注入測試氣體到數個壓力點，記錄前級壓力與入口壓力，斜率的倒數就是 K₀，氮與氫各做一次；在實際氣體負載下記錄前級壓力並確認低於額定上限；高流量時監看控制器回報的轉子溫度與馬達電流，並確認泵在額定最大流量下仍保持全速。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure K₀: blank the inlet, admit test gas into the foreline through a needle valve at several pressure points, log foreline and inlet pressures, and the inverse slope is K₀, once for nitrogen and once for hydrogen; under the real gas load log the foreline pressure and confirm it stays below the rated limit; at high throughput watch the rotor temperature and motor current reported by the controller and confirm the pump holds full speed at its rated maximum throughput.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 入口極限壓力 p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S。前級總壓 5×10⁻² mbar（渦卷泵），其中氫分壓 1×10⁻⁴ mbar（教學假設）。氮：5×10⁻²/10¹¹ = 5×10⁻¹³ mbar，可忽略。氫：混合泵 K₀(H₂) = 10⁵ 時為 10⁻⁴/10⁵ = 1×10⁻⁹ mbar；舊式純渦輪泵 K₀(H₂) = 10³ 時為 1×10⁻⁷ mbar。若腔體氫出氣 Q = 2×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s、S = 260 L/s，出氣項為 7.7×10⁻¹² mbar，比氫回流項小得多，所以這台泵站的下限由前級氫分壓與 K₀(H₂) 決定，而不是由泵的抽速決定。
knowledge.textEn: Inlet ultimate pressure p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S. Foreline total 5×10⁻² mbar from a scroll pump, with a hydrogen partial pressure of 1×10⁻⁴ mbar (teaching assumption). Nitrogen: 5×10⁻²/10¹¹ = 5×10⁻¹³ mbar, negligible. Hydrogen: with a hybrid pump of K₀(H₂) = 10⁵ it is 10⁻⁴/10⁵ = 1×10⁻⁹ mbar; with an older pure turbo pump of K₀(H₂) = 10³ it is 1×10⁻⁷ mbar. If chamber hydrogen outgassing is Q = 2×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s and S = 260 L/s, the outgassing term is 7.7×10⁻¹² mbar, far below the hydrogen backflow term, so this station's floor is set by foreline hydrogen and K₀(H₂), not by the pump's speed.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「壓縮比、前級壓力與極限壓力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Compression ratio, foreline pressure and ultimate pressure", which statement holds?
options: 入口極限壓力 p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S。
新真空計出廠就校正好了，裝上去的讀值就是絕對值。
渦輪泵只要在轉，任何腔體壓力下都可以開閘閥。
optionsEn: Inlet ultimate pressure p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S.
A new gauge comes calibrated from the factory, so its installed reading is absolute.
Once the turbopump is spinning the gate valve can be opened at any chamber pressure.
quiz.explanation: 入口極限壓力 p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Inlet ultimate pressure p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壓縮比、前級壓力與極限壓力：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Compression ratio, foreline pressure and ultimate pressure: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「前級管路與 Holweck 段」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Foreline and Holweck stage” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 量 K₀：封住入口，從前級以針閥注入測試氣體到數個壓力點，記錄前級壓力與入口壓力，斜率的倒數就是 K₀，氮與氫各做一次；在實際氣體負載下記錄前級壓力並確認低於額定上限；高流量時監看控制器回報的轉子溫度與馬達電流，並確認泵在額定最大流量下仍保持全速。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure K₀: blank the inlet, admit test gas into the foreline through a needle valve at several pressure points, log foreline and inlet pressures, and the inverse slope is K₀, once for nitrogen and once for hydrogen; under the real gas load log the foreline pressure and confirm it stays below the rated limit; at high throughput watch the rotor temperature and motor current reported by the controller and confirm the pump holds full speed at its rated maximum throughput. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：前級管路有空氣洩漏或前級泵老化，前級壓力爬過容許上限：壓縮比崩潰、入口壓力跳升數個數量級，轉子因氣體摩擦發熱而由溫度保護停機；若前級是油封旋片泵，油蒸氣還會在這段期間回流進腔體，留下碳氫污染。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: An air leak in the foreline or an ageing backing pump pushes the foreline pressure past its permitted limit: the compression collapses, the inlet pressure jumps by orders of magnitude, and the rotor, heated by gas friction, is stopped by its temperature protection; with an oil-sealed rotary-vane backing pump, oil vapour also backstreams into the chamber during this interval and leaves hydrocarbon contamination.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量 K₀：封住入口，從前級以針閥注入測試氣體到數個壓力點，記錄前級壓力與入口壓力，斜率的倒數就是 K₀，氮與氫各做一次；在實際氣體負載下記錄前級壓力並確認低於額定上限；高流量時監看控制器回報的轉子溫度與馬達電流，並確認泵在額定最大流量下仍保持全速。
knowledge.textEn: Measure K₀: blank the inlet, admit test gas into the foreline through a needle valve at several pressure points, log foreline and inlet pressures, and the inverse slope is K₀, once for nitrogen and once for hydrogen; under the real gas load log the foreline pressure and confirm it stays below the rated limit; at high throughput watch the rotor temperature and motor current reported by the controller and confirm the pump holds full speed at its rated maximum throughput.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓縮比、前級壓力與極限壓力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Compression ratio, foreline pressure and ultimate pressure"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
量 K₀：封住入口，從前級以針閥注入測試氣體到數個壓力點，記錄前級壓力與入口壓力，斜率的倒數就是 K₀，氮與氫各做一次。
磁浮渦輪泵完全免維護，不需要任何監測。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

Measure K₀: blank the inlet, admit test gas into the foreline through a needle valve at several pressure points, log foreline and inlet pressures, and the inverse slope is K₀, once for nitrogen and once for hydrogen.
A magnetically levitated turbopump is maintenance-free and needs no monitoring at all.
quiz.explanation: 量 K₀：封住入口，從前級以針閥注入測試氣體到數個壓力點，記錄前級壓力與入口壓力，斜率的倒數就是 K₀，氮與氫各做一次；在實際氣體負載下記錄前級壓力並確認低於額定上限；高流量時監看控制器回報的轉子溫度與馬達電流，並確認泵在額定最大流量下仍保持全速。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure K₀: blank the inlet, admit test gas into the foreline through a needle valve at several pressure points, log foreline and inlet pressures, and the inverse slope is K₀, once for nitrogen and once for hydrogen; under the real gas load log the foreline pressure and confirm it stays below the rated limit; at high throughput watch the rotor temperature and motor current reported by the controller and confirm the pump holds full speed at its rated maximum throughput. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 壓縮比、前級壓力與極限壓力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Compression ratio, foreline pressure and ultimate pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「前級管路與 Holweck 段」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Foreline and Holweck stage” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 前級管路有空氣洩漏或前級泵老化，前級壓力爬過容許上限：壓縮比崩潰、入口壓力跳升數個數量級，轉子因氣體摩擦發熱而由溫度保護停機；若前級是油封旋片泵，油蒸氣還會在這段期間回流進腔體，留下碳氫污染。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: An air leak in the foreline or an ageing backing pump pushes the foreline pressure past its permitted limit: the compression collapses, the inlet pressure jumps by orders of magnitude, and the rotor, heated by gas friction, is stopped by its temperature protection; with an oil-sealed rotary-vane backing pump, oil vapour also backstreams into the chamber during this interval and leaves hydrocarbon contamination. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：高氣體流量時轉子被氣體摩擦加熱，馬達功率與轉子溫度上限（鋁合金潛變）決定了泵的最大流量與最大前級壓力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At high throughput gas friction heats the rotor, and the motor power together with the rotor temperature limit (creep of the aluminium alloy) fixes the pump's maximum throughput and maximum foreline pressure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「前級壓力只要低於 1 mbar，對渦輪泵入口壓力就沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as the foreline stays below 1 mbar it has no effect on the inlet pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 前級管路有空氣洩漏或前級泵老化，前級壓力爬過容許上限：壓縮比崩潰、入口壓力跳升數個數量級，轉子因氣體摩擦發熱而由溫度保護停機；若前級是油封旋片泵，油蒸氣還會在這段期間回流進腔體，留下碳氫污染。
knowledge.textEn: An air leak in the foreline or an ageing backing pump pushes the foreline pressure past its permitted limit: the compression collapses, the inlet pressure jumps by orders of magnitude, and the rotor, heated by gas friction, is stopped by its temperature protection; with an oil-sealed rotary-vane backing pump, oil vapour also backstreams into the chamber during this interval and leaves hydrocarbon contamination.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壓縮比、前級壓力與極限壓力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Compression ratio, foreline pressure and ultimate pressure" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
渦輪泵只是個轉得快的風扇，撞機頂多換一台泵。

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A turbopump is just a fast fan, and a crash at worst means replacing the pump.

quiz.explanationEn: An air leak in the foreline or an ageing backing pump pushes the foreline pressure past its permitted limit: the compression collapses, the inlet pressure jumps by orders of magnitude, and the rotor, heated by gas friction, is stopped by its temperature protection; with an oil-sealed rotary-vane backing pump, oil vapour also backstreams into the chamber during this interval and leaves hydrocarbon contamination.
